sentences.en: Hot lemon with honey is a good remedy for colds.
sentences.zh: 喝热柠檬蜂蜜水是治疗感冒的好方法。

sentences.en: To he who is sick, honey has a bitter taste.
sentences.zh: 对于生病的人来说，蜂蜜尝起来是苦的。

sentences.en: I always add a spoonful of honey to my tea.
sentences.zh: 我总是往茶里加一勺蜂蜜。

senses.zh: 蜜，(复数)蜂蜜，甜，甜蜜，宝贝，爱人
